content.description: Lot photographed as a folded stack in three colours (maroon, light blue, beige) and two laid-flat garments (light blue and beige). The laid-flat garments are stitched, straight-cut, knee-length tunic shirts with short sleeves and a wide neckline, each with a hanging tag reading M. One photographed care/content label reads SIZE M and 100% COTTON LAWN; it also carries wording that may describe set composition. Only shirts are visible; no trousers or dupattas are shown. The maroon item is shown folded only, so its cut and whether it is stitched cannot be confirmed. No stains, holes or fading are visible, but the photographs are not detailed enough to inspect stitching, finishing or fabric surface.
